title.description: A short descriptive name, with an acronym

summary.description: Two to four sentences: the idea, its components, and the limitations it resolves

addresses.description: Ids of the limitations the idea addresses, such as L2

method.description: The method, component by component: what each does, the limitation it addresses, its equations or algorithm, and the default value of every new hyperparameter

implementation_plan.description: Ordered steps that change the codebase, naming files and functions where known

expected_effect.description: Which metric should move, in which direction, on which inputs, and why

risks.description: What could make the idea fail, and how a failure would show in results or logs
